scripts.deploy: sh -lc 'if [ -z "${CLOUDFLARE_API_BASE_URL:-}" ]; then ORIGIN="${CHIRIDION_PUBLIC_ORIGIN:-${CHIRIDION_BASE_URL:-}}"; test -n "$ORIGIN" || (echo "CHIRIDION_PUBLIC_ORIGIN (or CLOUDFLARE_API_BASE_URL) is required" >&2; exit 1); export CLOUDFLARE_API_BASE_URL="${ORIGIN%/}/client/v4"; fi; wrangler deploy --dispatch-namespace ignored --name ignored'
